label: Transform
gloss: parse, normalize, or compute so the data is safe to compare
why: Raw fields are rarely in the shape a decision needs. A transform computes or normalizes a value and writes it onto the record, so the step after it compares clean numbers instead of guessing. At Beacon, the invoice bills 1220 and the PO says 1200; the transform writes variance = 20, and that one number is what the desk decides on.
cue: any time two values must be compared, ask what shape they are in first; comparison before normalization is where silent bugs live
task: Compute how far the invoice is from its PO: set variance to invoiceTotal minus po.poTotal.
notes: Set: a field name and an expression; the result is written onto the record.
Expressions read record fields by name and nested ones by dotted path (po.poTotal).
Arithmetic on a missing field gives null, not a crash - look for null in the trace.

dialect.powerAutomate: 'Compose', 'Select', 'Parse JSON', or an expression like float()
dialect.powerAppsCopilot: a Power Fx formula, or a Copilot Studio variable expression
dialect.make: an Iterator plus a Set variable / text parser module
dialect.n8n: a Set, Code, or Item Lists node
dialect.python: a parsing function; pandas.to_numeric or re.sub for cleaning
dialect.langgraph: a node function that rewrites state, or a structured-output extraction call
